pennsylvania state clearinghouse project notification and review system
PNRS Letter of Intent for:
project: Drajx EIS - H.R. 1311
location: nationvile
applicant: US Rept Interior PSCH number: 72-04-2-039
This letter acknowledges receipt on 4/3/72 of your, PNRS Letter of Intent or materials that we may use as such, and perhaps other information relative to the above project. This Letter of Intent has been distributed to a number of State agencies; other summary-type materials received or which you may care to forward to the State Glearinghouse will be made available to any State agency expressing interest in this project. For State Clearinghouse purposes this project has been assigned the number shown above.
You will be advised by letter orginated within 30 days of the above date either that we need further information on your project or that you are cleared to file the application. In all cases, potential applicants are subject to Regional Clearinghouse procedures where they are operative, as well as those of the State Clearinghouse.
Should you have any questions about Circular A-95 revised, the Project Notification and Review System, or your intended application, please feel free to communicate with us.
Sincerely,
Richard A. Heiss
State Coordinator, PNRS
Kicken 111 Heins
PSCH-1
